wave1.description: TanStack CI/CD hijack (mid-May 2026) — 84 malicious versions across 42 packages in ~6 minutes via compromised GitHub Actions CI. Forged SLSA BL3 provenance attestations.

iocs.notes: Seed IOC — update from threat intel feed. Affected: @tanstack/router, @tanstack/react-router, @tanstack/query, @tanstack/form, @tanstack/store, @tanstack/virtual, @tanstack/ranger, @tanstack/table.

wave2.description: AntV/atool maintainer account compromise (late May 2026) — 600+ malicious versions across 300+ packages in ~22 minutes. ~16M weekly download blast radius.

iocs.notes: Seed IOC — compromised @antv/atool maintainer account. Update compromise window from threat intel.
Blast radius: @antv/g2, @antv/g6, @antv/x6, @antv/l7, echarts-for-react, timeago.js. Seed IOC — update from threat intel.

wave3.description: Nx Console 18.95.0 VS Code extension compromise (May 18, 2026, CVE-2026-48027, TeamPCP) — contributor token stolen via TanStack wave1 (May 11), 7-day dwell, malicious extension published using npx to fetch 498KB obfuscated Bun payload from dangling orphan commit on nrwl/nx repo. ~3M installs exposed.
